title: PDNI memo waives UAP NDAs
summary: Tim Gallaudet tells of PDNI memo waives UAP NDAs, about 2026 at Office of the Director of National Intelligence, US, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Office of the Director of National Intelligence, US

tellings.quote: okay, Aaron Lucas just sent out a memo >> per the president's directive saying that if anybody has information regarding UAP and they had to sign an NDA that the NDAs will be waved
